name: Diageo plc
summary: Diageo plc, an entity established in 1886 with its headquarters located in London, United Kingdom, specializes in the development, promotion, and worldwide distribution of an extensive array of alcoholic beverages. Its diverse product portfolio features a wide selection of spirits, including various whiskies such as Scotch, Canadian, Irish, American, and Indian-Made Foreign Liquor, alongside gin, vodka, rum, tequila, brandy, liqueurs, raki, Chinese white spirits, and cachaça. Beyond spirits, the company also offers wines, beers (encompassing cider and flavored malt beverages), ready-to-drink options, and non-alcoholic products. These items are marketed under numerous prominent global brands, notably Johnnie Walker, Guinness, Tanqueray, Baileys, Smirnoff, Captain Morgan, Crown Royal, Don Julio, Cîroc, Buchanan's, Casamigos, J&B, and Ketel One. Diageo operates with a substantial international footprint, conducting business across countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Australia, Korea, India, Greater China, Brazil, Mexico, South Africa, and Nigeria, among other global markets.
